CanonicalQueryMetricsOutput.description:
Process-cumulative actual query builder / SDK response populations. Not every SDK
select/control API uses this query adapter; no server-wide coverage is claimed.

builders.description: Query builders constructed; never interpreted as dispatched requests.

request_failures.description: SDK observer request failures without statement responses.

saturated.description: A count or duration saturated; exact increases are unavailable after this point.

server_duration_nanos.description: Sum of supplied server statement wall times, in nanoseconds; not CPU time.

source_started_unix_micros.description: First observed query-owner event; absent before any owner activity.

statements.description: Actual statements received before caller consumption, including failures.

statements_untimed.description: Statements lacking server execution time; absent is not zero duration.

DiagnosticProcessSummaryOutput.description: One discovered process prefix; errors retain the path without implying an empty process.

failure.description: Optional decode/access error, independent of simulation success.

operations.description: Bounded available operation catalogue from this image.

partial.description: Image omitted observations or registry collection was curtailed.

process.description: Process diagnostic identity, if the image is readable.

runtime_metrics.description: Measurements from this checkpoint, absent when the source image is unavailable.

summaries.description: Explicit producer-summary admission, expiry and pressure losses when readable.

ExecutorMetricsSnapshotOutput.description: Copied stable Tokio facts. Gauges are independently read, not an atomic scheduler census.

alive_tasks.description: Tokio's approximate current count, in tasks; not a settlement proof.

global_queue_depth.description: Current global injection queue depth, in tasks; excludes worker-local queues.

identity.description: Process-local registration identity, scoped by the enclosing process locator.

registered_unix_micros.description: Wall time this source was registered; counters originate at runtime construction.

worker_busy_nanos.description:
Sum of cumulative worker busy durations, in nanoseconds since runtime construction.
Unavailable on targets without 64-bit atomics; not process or operation CPU time.

OperationIdBody.description: Process instance plus local sequence; never a semantic or cache identity.

process_instance.description: Process-local instance locator; not a semantic identity or attestation.

OperationSummaryOutput.description: Small copied catalogue entry without metric or scientific ownership.

finished_at.description: Actual owner completion time, when known.

id.description: Diagnostic identity of the associated operation.

kind.description: Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.

outcome.description: Explicit owner terminal explanation, or none while active or unavailable.

summary.description: Producer-declared responsibility and finite copied-output lifetime.

OperationalMetricsSnapshotOutput.description: Copied owner totals. Acquisition callers and shared producers are overlapping populations.

native_admitted.description: Actual active CPU/memory admissions in this supervisor route.

native_attempts.description: Attempts entering the native supervisor admission route; not scientific solves.

native_cancel_requests.description: User-cancellation branch selections while join was still pending.

native_deadline_requests.description: Deadline branch selections while join was still pending.

native_dispatched.description: Worker threads successfully spawned by this route.

native_joined.description: Threads witnessed joined, including TLS/foreign destruction.

native_supervisors.description: Current outstanding supervisor owners; not a physical-release proof.

preparation.description: Exactly frontier and basis shared-preparation populations.

saturated.description: A process counter saturated; exact increase queries must decline this source.

source_started_unix_micros.description: First owner activity in Unix microseconds; SDK collection start is different.

PreparationCountsBody.description:
Structural preparations and value rebinds: of a math service, or of one operation such
as a study (A6).

rebuilt.description: Value rebinds that rebuilt value-dependent products because a consumed value changed.

shared.description: Value rebinds that shared every product because no consumed value changed.

views.description:
Structural solver-view preparations: a case plan, structural analysis and artifact
requests built from a bound structure.

PreparationMetricsSnapshot.description: One shared-product stage, process cumulative; misses supply no inferred invalidation cause.

acquisitions.description: Valid acquisition callers, including retained readers and all flight waiters.

flight_waiters.description: Polled caller flight attempts after the retained probe missed; includes capacity/retiring refusals. Producer ownership is separate.

producers.description: Single-flight producer executions, including a retained-product recheck.

retained_reuses.description: Retained products reused, including producer cache rechecks.

ProcessLocatorBodyOutput.description: Actual process locator. PID reuse must be checked before attaching an optional sampler.

executable.description: Current executable path for display/symbol discovery, not a content proof.

start_ticks.description: Linux process start ticks; absence does not authorize attachment.

RuntimeMetricsCoverage.description: Coverage of the bounded executor source registry at this read.

executor_registry_available.description: False when source synchronization was unavailable; an empty list then is not zero load.

refused_executor_registrations.description: Cumulative refused registrations, including registry pressure or synchronization failure.

task_scope.description: Only explicitly instrumented futures are covered by task class measurements.

RuntimeMetricsSnapshotOutput.description: One read of the same typed sources used by checkpoints and optional OTel export.

canonical_queries.description: Selected canonical Query-adapter SDK statistics; excludes other SDK APIs.

coverage.description: Explicit registry losses and selected task coverage.

executors.description: At most eight actual registered executors.

locator.description: Actual process/start locator; absence of start ticks limits identity evidence.

operational.description: Same cumulative native/shared-preparation source read by OTel callbacks.

preparations.description: Performing-owner preparation totals; nested operation/service summaries overlap.

sampled_unix_micros.description: Wall time immediately before independently sampled source reads.

task_classes.description: Exactly three process-wide selected future classes.

SummaryCoverage.description: Explicit lifetime/admission losses for producer-declared compact outputs.

expired.description: Outputs whose selected terminal lifetime elapsed.

pressure_lost.description: Oldest terminal outputs displaced to preserve active admission.

refused.description: Declarations or terminal copies refused by bounds/contention/opt-out.

SummaryPublicationOutput.description: Generic producer-owned compact explanation; it grants no execution ownership.

expires_at.description: Finite terminal output deadline; absent for an active declaration or a refused copy.

purpose.description: Bounded producer-supplied purpose, never interpreted by the hub.

TaskClassMetricsSnapshot.description: Cumulative library task monitor facts for a bounded class, in counts and nanoseconds.

dropped_count.description: Wrappers dropped, including cancellation; never a native settlement counter.

first_poll_count.description: Tasks polled for the first time; excludes wrappers never polled.

idle_nanos.description: Cumulative pending-to-wake idle time, in nanoseconds.

instrumented_count.description: Number of wrappers created, not native jobs admitted.

long_delay_count.description: Wake-to-poll delays meeting the long-delay threshold.

long_delay_nanos.description: Cumulative long wake-to-poll delays, in nanoseconds; subset of scheduled time.

long_delay_threshold_nanos.description: Actual monitor threshold classifying long wake-to-poll delays, in nanoseconds.

poll_nanos.description: Cumulative time within future polls, in nanoseconds; not CPU time.

slow_poll_count.description: Polls meeting the monitor's slow-poll threshold.

slow_poll_nanos.description: Cumulative time within slow polls, in nanoseconds; subset of poll time.

slow_poll_threshold_nanos.description: Actual monitor threshold classifying slow polls, in nanoseconds.

source_started_unix_micros.description: Cumulative source generation starts when this process-wide monitor was created.

next.description: Exclusive filename cursor when another page may exist.
